summary: Frontend-only E2E testing for BITS in Motion. Verified onboarding → dashboard flow, localStorage persistence (key 'bits_in_motion_data'), backpack prefix on weighted exercises, low-impact swap (Squats→Wall Sit, Push-ups→Knee Push-ups), sound-toggle, Settings save/toggle/reset, history seeding + clear, and Camera Coach (fake webcam produced HUD with rep-counter-display, phase-badge, form-cue, form-ring, finish-workout-btn; finish returned to dashboard). Reset-app returned to onboarding. All critical flows pass with no crashes.

issues: Recharts emits 'width(-1) and height(-1)' console warnings on initial paint (ResponsiveContainer parent size race). Not visually broken but noisy console. Suggest setting a fixed min-height on the container div or using aspect prop.

action_items: Optional: silence recharts ResponsiveContainer size warning by giving the wrapping div an explicit min-height (or use aspect ratio).
critical_code_review_comments: Storage/context are clean and idempotent; profile persisted correctly.
Exercise filter/swap logic correct: goal='strength' returns squats/pushups/lunges; lowImpact swaps to wallsit/kneepushups; backpack prefix applied only to weighted exercises.
Camera Coach handles fake webcam gracefully — HUD renders, no crash. Rep count with static fake video is 0 as expected.
MediaPipe WebGL 'GPU stall due to ReadPixels' warnings originate in the mediapipe runtime, not app code — non-actionable.
seed_data_creation: Seeded 3 history entries (squats/pushups/plank) via localStorage during test; cleared afterward using clear-history flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All data-testids are present and stable. Chromium fake-webcam flags produce a running HUD but 0 reps (expected). Only cosmetic recharts console warning remains.
